### Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and K-Means Clustering

<!-- Name every code chunk with a unique label starting with "pca-",
     e.g. ```{r pca-fit}. Duplicate chunk names across section files stop
     the knit. -->

#### Data Preparation for Clustering & PCA

```{r pca-dummies}
library(fastDummies)
dummy_heart <- dummy_cols(
  heart,
  select_columns = c("Sex", "ChestPainType", "RestingECG", "FastingBS", "ExerciseAngina", "ST_Slope"),
  remove_first_dummy = TRUE,
  remove_selected_columns = TRUE
)

dummy_heart$Cholesterol[dummy_heart$Cholesterol == 0] <- NA
dummy_heart$RestingBP[dummy_heart$RestingBP == 0]     <- NA

# 2. Impute with dataset medians
chol_med <- median(dummy_heart$Cholesterol, na.rm = TRUE)
bp_med   <- median(dummy_heart$RestingBP,   na.rm = TRUE)

dummy_heart$Cholesterol[is.na(dummy_heart$Cholesterol)] <- chol_med
dummy_heart$RestingBP[is.na(dummy_heart$RestingBP)]     <- bp_med

# Scale predictors only (excluding HeartDisease so clustering & PCA are unsupervised)
scaled_predictors <- scale(dummy_heart[, colnames(dummy_heart) != "HeartDisease"])
```

#### K-Means Clustering

```{r pca-kmeans-elbow}
twcss <- numeric(10)
for (k in 1:10) {
  set.seed(380)
  km <- kmeans(scaled_predictors, centers = k, nstart = 25)
  twcss[k] <- km$tot.withinss
}

plot(1:10, twcss, type = "b", pch = 19, frame = FALSE,
     xlab = "Number of clusters K",
     ylab = "Total Within-Cluster Sum of Squares (TWCSS)",
     main = "Elbow Method to Choose K")
```

```{r pca-kmeans-silhouette}
library(cluster)
avg_sil <- numeric()
for (k in 2:10) {
  set.seed(380)
  km <- kmeans(scaled_predictors, centers = k, nstart = 25)
  sil <- silhouette(km$cluster, dist(scaled_predictors))
  avg_sil[k] <- mean(sil[, 3])
}

plot(2:10, avg_sil[2:10], type = "b", pch = 19, frame = FALSE,
     xlab = "Number of clusters K",
     ylab = "Average Silhouette Width",
     main = "Silhouette Method to Choose K")
```
```{r}
pairs(~ Age + RestingBP + Cholesterol + MaxHR + Oldpeak, 
      data = dummy_heart,
      main = "Pairwise Scatter Plot of Heart Data",
      pch = 19)
```


```{r pca-kmeans-fit}
k <- 3
set.seed(380)
km <- kmeans(scaled_predictors, centers = k, nstart = 25)

heart_df <- as.data.frame(scaled_predictors)
heart_df$cluster <- km$cluster
km$size
km$centers
```

#### Principal Component Analysis (PCA)

```{r pca-fit}
pca_heart <- prcomp(scaled_predictors, scale. = FALSE)
summary(pca_heart)
```

```{r pca-scree}
eigvals <- pca_heart$sdev^2

plot(eigvals, type = "b", pch = 19,
     xlab = "Principal Component",
     ylab = "Eigenvalue (Variance Explained)",
     main = "Scree Plot")
```

```{r pca-loadings}
pca_heart$rotation
```

```{r pca-plot-clusters}
pca_plot_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_heart$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_heart$x[, 2],
  cluster = factor(km$cluster)
)

ggplot(pca_plot_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2.5) +
  labs(
    title = "K-Means Clusters on Heart Dataset (PCA Space)",
    x = "Principal Component 1 (PC1)",
    y = "Principal Component 2 (PC2)",
    color = "Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r pca-plot-disease}
pca_disease_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_heart$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_heart$x[, 2],
  HeartDisease = factor(heart$HeartDisease)
)

ggplot(pca_disease_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = HeartDisease)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Actual Heart Disease Status in PCA Space",
    x = "Principal Component 1 (PC1)",
    y = "Principal Component 2 (PC2)",
    color = "Heart Disease"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
